item.title: Religious leaders demand answers after taco vendor taken by federal agents at North Hills church
item.description: Local religious leaders are denouncing the actions of federal immigration agents who arrested a man on the grounds of North Hills United Methodist Church last week.

item.title: From 'Wolverine' healing claims to health warnings: The unregulated rise of peptides
item.description: Peptides are one of the newest trends in the beauty industry. But how do they work and are they safe?

item.title: Mayor Bass delivers State of the City speech on LA's prep for big sporting events
item.description: Mayor Karen Bass delivered a State of the City address, speaking on a wide range of topics, including immigration and the major sporting events coming to L.A. over the next three years.

item.title: Lancaster parents sentenced to life in prison for decapitating their two children
item.description: A Lancaster father and mother have been sentenced to life in prison for the murder of their two children who were found decapitated inside their home.

item.title: CA Teamsters call for suspension of Waymo's operating license after child hit in Santa Monica
item.description: The Teamsters Union of California is asking the state to suspend Waymo's operating license in the state indefinitely after one of the company's self-driving cars hit a child in Santa Monica last month.

item.title: Vandals destroy Virgin Mary statue, trash classrooms during break-in at Long Beach Catholic school
item.description: Vandals destroyed a Virgin Mary statue and caused widespread destruction when they broke into a Long Beach Catholic school.

item.title: SoCal to see near-record heat, return of Santa Ana winds this week
item.description: Southern California this week can expect to see Santa Ana winds and temperatures rise into the 80s in some parts.

item.title: LA County reports third measles case in the past week; all cases are travel-related
item.description: The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health said the three measles cases reported in the past week are not related. All three patients recently traveled internationally.

item.title: Santa Clarita girls hockey team wins tournament after deadly Colorado crash
item.description: A Santa Clarita girls hockey team chose to play through their pain after they were involved in a deadly crash in Colorado, and now, they're bringing home a trophy.

item.title: Viral video of teen's arrest in Lynwood is tied to Anaheim jewelry store robbery, police say
item.description: Anaheim police are setting the record straight about a smash-and-grab suspect after a video of a teen's arrest went viral, with witnesses thinking federal agents were involved.
